title: Agents reach for the Dashboard browser, and it can run a page script
notes: Retro 2026-11-24: 0 mcp__dashboard__browser_* calls against 140+ Playwright / Claude in Chrome calls (1 KB javascript_tool cap, 'outside allowed roots', extension disconnects, 1.6 MB of zoom screenshots on LinkedIn). Main's own brief sent the job-search worker to Chrome. (1) The MCP server instruction (src/main/command/mcp-tools.ts) says when to choose the Dashboard browser: a page to read or check, signed-in per project, no 1 KB cap. Main's prompt (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts) and the work-card skill name it for any page or frontend check; the review prompt (src/main/ship/review.ts) for a layout check on the running app. (2) A 'browser eval <tab> <script file>' verb (and MCP tool) through an action, Runtime.evaluate already used in browser-page.ts, its result written to a file and a short line printed; plus a --wait-for <selector> option so page scripts stop sleeping. Docs in docs/browser/.
